sessionStart.command: node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process');const p=require('node:path');const r=cp.execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','--show-toplevel'],{encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true}).trim();require(p.join(r,'scripts/agent-tools.cjs')).main(process.argv.slice(1)).then(c=>{process.exitCode=c;}).catch(e=>{console.error('TCT tools: '+(process.argv[1]==='hook'?'Hook could not run; check local setup.':e.message));process.exitCode=1;});" hook cursor SessionStart
